password.description: Enter your current password, then the new one. You stay signed in on your other devices.

rules.title: Your new password
rules.email: Not the part of your email before the @
rules.common: Not a very common password. We check this when you save.

admin.title: Settings
admin.emailNote: Your sign-in email. It can’t be changed here.
admin.allClearText: Nothing is waiting for a review.

privacy.title: Choose how you’re discovered
privacy.description: Your resume isn’t shared just because your profile is visible.

discoverable.label: Profile visibility & recruiter discovery
discoverable.description: Allow recruiters to find your profile, listed skills and career preferences. Turn this off to keep your profile private. Companies you applied to still see your application.

resumeVisible.label: Resume visibility
resumeVisible.description: Allow recruiters who find your profile to open your live CV. Companies you applied to can always open the CV you sent.

matchingConsent.label: Matching consent
matchingConsent.description: Allow your profile to be used in AI matching. No protected characteristics are used.

privacy.note: Every download of your CV is logged.

layout.title: Your workspace. Your terms.
layout.description: Simple controls for your privacy, notifications, and personal information.

data.title: Understand and control your data
data.notice: Your account data is stored on EU Jobs servers. Download a copy whenever you like, or delete your account and personal data.

export.label: Download your data
export.description: A ZIP file with your records as JSON and the files you uploaded.

delete.label: Delete my data
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and personal data. Payment records are kept for accounting with your name removed.
delete.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your account, profile, CV versions, applications, messages, job alerts, learning progress, certificates and verification evidence. A Plus plan is cancelled at once, without a refund. Payment records are kept with your name removed. You will be signed out. This can’t be undone.
delete.password: Enter your current password to confirm.

deleteRecruiter.label: Delete account
deleteRecruiter.description: Close your jobs and permanently delete your account and personal data. Payment records are kept for accounting with your name removed.
deleteRecruiter.confirmBody: Your jobs are closed and your KYC documents, candidate notes, shortlist and activity are deleted. A Recruiter Plus plan is cancelled at once, without a refund. Candidates keep their applications and conversations under your company’s display name. Payment records are kept with your name removed. You will be signed out. This can’t be undone.
deleteRecruiter.password: Enter your current password to confirm.
